_approach: The gallop kick from the groove set intensifies into a full kick roll: bar 1 has the soft gallop 16ths growing louder, bar 2 turns every 16th into a kick hit ramping 100 to 127 while the clap doubles into 8ths behind it. A hard cutoff (all tracks silent on the last 16th) sets up the drop's first hit to land in the gap — the 'silence before impact' trick krushclub shares with trap/hyperpop builds.
